subject: Life Skills
title: Document Safety
description: A quick win: understand Document Safety.

hook.text: His passport was stolen in Barcelona. No copy, no backup, no embassy number saved. He was stranded for five days.

buildup.text: Losing your passport abroad is stressful but survivable — if you prepared. Without copies, recovery takes days or weeks.

discovery.text: Before any trip: photograph your passport, visa, and insurance cards.

twist.text: Carry a paper photocopy separately from the original. If your phone dies or gets stolen.

climax.text: Save your country's nearest embassy address and phone number in your contacts. You need it before you need it.

punchline.text: Copy, cloud, paper. Three backups, zero panic.

quiz.question: What is the best way to back up travel documents?
options: Keep only digital copies on your phone
Store copies in the cloud, on your phone, and on paper separately
Leave originals at home and travel with copies
